body_html:
#PoetryPort Epilogue
A final gift to https://david.shanske.com for being a tireless WordPress warrior on the hunt for a bookmark he can't like
a found poem of parsed p-names pulled from child like h-cites, a digital dadaism swimming in metadata
Greedy Bears
Raven pulls on a rat
drape the couches
Lot's Wife
shade
saving sight and men
pets of prosperity
strangers
history's horsefly
birch tree
miseries on glories
welcoming strangers
victories of soul
to another
Poetry is Welcoming
new beginnings.
